## Need Assistance?

Our help center provides comprehensive support resources to help you get the most out of the platform. Whether you're a new user or an experienced analyst, you'll find documentation, tutorials, and troubleshooting guides tailored to your needs.

For immediate assistance, please refer to our FAQ section below or contact our support team through the channels listed in the support resources table.

## Support Resources

Browse our available support resources and their current status:

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Create sample support resources data
support_data <- data.frame(
  Resource_Type = c("Documentation", "Video Tutorials", "Live Chat", "Email Support",
                    "Phone Support", "Community Forum", "API Reference", "Webinars",
                    "Knowledge Base", "Status Page", "Training Sessions", "Release Notes"),
  Availability = c("24/7", "24/7", "9AM-5PM EST", "24/7", "9AM-8PM EST",
                   "24/7", "24/7", "Weekly", "24/7", "24/7", "Scheduled", "Monthly"),
  Response_Time = c("Instant", "Instant", "< 5 min", "< 4 hours", "< 30 min",
                    "Varies", "Instant", "N/A", "Instant", "Instant", "N/A", "N/A"),
  Monthly_Usage = c(3421, 1876, 543, 234, 89, 2341, 876, 156, 2987, 1234, 67, 543),
  Satisfaction = c(4.7, 4.8, 4.6, 4.5, 4.8, 4.3, 4.6, 4.9, 4.7, 4.4, 4.9, 4.5)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Priority = case_when(
      Monthly_Usage > 2000 ~ "High",
      Monthly_Usage > 500 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    ),
    Satisfaction_Pct = round(Satisfaction * 20, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Monthly_Usage))

# Create interactive table
datatable(support_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 12,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            columnDefs = list(
              list(targets = 3, render = JS(
                "function(data, type, row, meta) {",
                "return type === 'display' ? data.toLocaleString() : data;",
                "}"
              ))
            )
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Support Resources Overview") %>%
  formatStyle('Priority',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('High', 'Medium', 'Low'),
                c('#d4edda', '#fff3cd', '#f8d7da')
              )) %>%
  formatRound('Satisfaction', 1) %>%
  formatPercentage('Satisfaction_Pct', 1)
```
